must_find.description: Independently of aliases, demo-reader invokes record.batch with {"names":["public/guide","private/roadmap"]}. Validation permits both well-formed names; resolve_batch canonicalizes both correctly but grants.issue checks only names[0] and returns a Grant covering the complete tuple. Dispatch then fetches every plan name, exposing private/roadmap in the second response item. No alias edit or grammar bypass is needed. Reversing the order or using a private-only single-item batch is denied, so the finding must identify first-item-only enforcement rather than claiming every batch bypasses authorization.
